agent_brief: Site is a 2016 WordPress build on an abandoned theme. Six seconds to first paint on 4G. No booking form, enquiries go to a Gmail address.
headline: Your site takes six seconds to load on a phone. Most callers are gone by second three.
intro: The current site scores 24 out of 100 on mobile in Google's own test, which puts it in their slowest band. For an emergency trade that is the whole problem: someone with a burst pipe is not waiting. The content and the photos are fine — the thing carrying them is nine years old.

audit_issues.impact: Over half of mobile visitors abandon a page that takes more than three seconds. For emergency callouts that is the majority of your traffic leaving before they see a phone number.
Every enquiry depends on someone tapping a phone number. Anyone browsing at 11pm with a leak has no way to reach you until morning.
The theme has had no security update since 2021, which is both a breach risk and the reason the site cannot be made fast without replacing it.
You rank for 'plumber Brisbane' and nothing else, while competitors hold the top spot in eleven separate suburbs.

style_direction: Clean and high-contrast, built to be read one-handed in bad light. Large tap targets, phone number visible at every scroll position, and photographs of actual jobs rather than stock imagery — for a trade, proof of work outperforms polish every time.

milestones.deliverable: Sitemap signed off, all eight pages written and approved, photography brief agreed.
Homepage and one interior page designed for mobile and desktop, presented for sign-off before any code is written.
Full site built on a maintained theme, booking form wired to SMS, suburb template driving all 12 location pages.
Cross-device testing, PageSpeed above 90 on mobile verified, redirects mapped from the old site, go live.
Four weeks of monitoring and fixes, plus a walkthrough so your team can update content.

pricing_tiers.name: Rebuild
pricing_tiers.tagline: The eight core pages, fast and bookable

payment_terms: 40% to commence, 30% at design sign-off, 30% on launch.
closing_note: The mobile speed problem cannot be fixed on the current theme — it is the theme. Everything else in this proposal follows from replacing it, which is why the rebuild is quoted as one piece rather than a list of patches.
disclaimer: Performance scores are measured at the time of writing and vary with network conditions and third-party scripts. Timeline assumes content and feedback are returned within three business days at each stage.
